Current Xenoverse 2 skill-list material places ID 10540 in the Evasive section.
Independent Demigra reference describes Energy Boil as Final Demigra's Evasive Skill: he surrounds himself in an energy sphere, teleports, then gathers Ki.
An independent Xenoverse 2 skills-unobtainable reference lists Energy Boil as Final Form Demigra's Evasive Skill.
limits: Evidence establishes Evasive classification and cast-only boundary, but does not establish the repository's attack subcategory taxonomy for Energy Boil.
Numeric Ki cost remains unresolved; Evasive Skills generally consume Stamina rather than Ki, so no Ki value is inferred.
No Future Warrior acquisition route is inferred.
